name: Nookery
summary: A home-goods sales CRM with a chart that morphs between five views and a row-style deal board
about: A sales CRM for a brand that sells online, on a marketplace, to shops and in its own store, shown with sample data from a Lahore home-goods studio. One sales chart melts between stacked, share, stream, bar and overlay views, wholesale deals slide along horizontal rows, and orders, products and channels are all editable.
how: Use the pill menu at the top (a slide-in sheet on phones) to move between the seven pages.
On Overview or Sales, press Stacked, Share, Stream, Bars or Overlay and watch the chart morph; switch 6M, 12M or 24M, or tap a channel in the legend to hide it.
On Deals, drag a card along to the next row; dropping it on Ordered creates a real order. Keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip button.
Open any deal or order to change its stage or status, edit or delete it with undo.
On Products, restock, list or unlist a piece on each channel, and edit or delete it.
On Channels, edit fees and targets or pause a channel; Settings saves the brand, alerts, theme and can reset the demo data.
Press Ctrl+K to search deals, products, pages and chart views.
